decisions.reason: Confirmed logic gap: an end disk tangent at its centre can have transverse coordinate b(u,0)=-u^2; cutting off only the other graph coordinates does not put it in S_i. Repaired step 4.1 by cutting off all normal coordinates toward (a(u,s),s,0), using C1 closeness of the (a,b) projection for injectivity and positive inward derivative for avoidance. The Statement is unchanged; free endpoint signs/disk orientations, codimension >=2 and AC_omega are retained.

Quotient compatibility omits the transverse normal sign: with k=2,n=4 and equally oriented end arcs, the band-sum reverses one circle, so its full ordered normal frame cannot match both unreflected originals. The repair chooses the first sphere framing, uses the seam-plane rotation to determine sigma at the second end, and reflects the first normal coordinate of that parallel copy when sigma=-1; the retained second handle is unchanged. Full framing gluing and the transported k=1 framing are explicit.

The decomposition supplier defines W_0 as the incoming collar. For a consecutive pair at positions i,i+1, its lower attaching map has target partial_+W_{i-1}, so W_0 union h^k can be undefined when i>1. Corrected the middle boundary to partial_+W_i=partial_+(W_{i-1} union h^k); the one-point predicate and all endpoint conventions are unchanged.

F3 quoted a core and lower-stage pair comparison absent from the diffeomorphism supplier, and the bare slide diffeomorphism generally moves A=W^{k-1}. Repaired with the actual inverse disk-push map G and H_t=K_t K_1^{-1}|A. The prism formula makes [Gz+P_H boundary z] a well-defined relative class. Its attaching-boundary trace crosses the parallel second core once with local degree +/-1; a capped sphere trace computes the coefficient. All other generators are fixed, so the elementary matrix is invertible. The Statement now specifies the necessary homotopy as part of the identification.

The old proof composed normalization and absorption then asserted support only near the final model disk E, although normalization is supported near its sweeps. Step 2.1 now constructs an enclosing original-boundary disk D from the full lower attaching tube and expelled upper cap, using the standard-ball model in dimensions n-1,k-1, then enlarges it to contain seam collars and all old-boundary sweeps. Isotopy extensions and final absorption are chosen in the same collar of D and the handles. This proves the stated existence of an affected support disk without claiming the support shrinks to the smaller final E. The Statement and endpoint range are unchanged.

repair_notes: Assigned five draft carriers reviewed and repaired in the generated increasing dependency order. No judgments, certification stamps, round state, other reports or consumer items were edited; no workers or judges launched. All findings are local adjudication/repair evidence, not independent audits of these repairs.

Band: original Statement unchanged. Missing exact containment of end disks repaired by modifying every normal coordinate in step 4.1; projected-chart injectivity and positive inward coordinate justify embeddedness and avoidance. F10 explicitly cites the existing choice-free inverse-function supplier. All 21 original supplier interfaces checked; codimension >=2, free endpoint sign/disk orientation and AC_omega retained.

Slide: ## Statement (the definition carrier) changed. Rank q-1 quotient compatibility does not control the omitted transverse line. Seam-plane rotation fixes the first framing and determines sigma on the second parallel copy; reflecting its first normal coordinate supplies full-frame gluing while leaving retained h2 unchanged. k=1 uses full framing transported across the parallel interval core. Eight direct consumers and the owning page use were examined.

Cancelling-pair definition: ## Statement changed from the undefined W_0 union lower handle for later positions to middle boundary partial_+W_i at positions i,i+1. All endpoint conventions and the one-point predicate retained. Thirteen direct consumers and page uses examined; their own middle-stage conventions or predicate-only uses remain sound.

Basis lemma: ## Statement now specifies the lower-stage homotopy in its relative comparison. F3 no longer quotes an unsupplied core comparison. The inverse disk-push diffeomorphism G and H_t=K_t K_1^{-1}|A yield the corrected relative cycle Gz+P_H boundary z; the prism identity proves representative independence. The capped boundary trace crosses the parallel second core once with local degree +/-1. All other generators fixed, giving an invertible elementary matrix. Existing published thm-singular-chain-homotopy-formula and thm-global-sphere-degree-is-the-sum-of-local-degrees are the exact new suppliers; their interfaces were read and cited. Six direct consumers examined.

Cancellation: original Statement unchanged. The full original lower attaching tube plus the expelled upper cap forms an (n-1)-disk by the standard-ball supplier with dimensions n-1,k-1. An enlargement D contains the old-boundary seam collars and normalization sweeps; extensions and final absorption are chosen in its collar and the handles. The support disk is D, not an arbitrary smaller final model E. The k=0 old-foot disk and q=1 zero-dimensional normal patch were checked.
